text_description: Runway look centered on a black, glossy leather-like sleeveless midi-to-ankle dress with a fluid yet structured A-line silhouette. The dress has very thin shoulder straps, a soft V neckline with slight gathering at the bust, exposed shoulders and arms, and a dropped/low waistline that releases into a voluminous skirt. The skirt is panelled with visible seam lines and a subtle sheen, flaring outward from the hips to a wide lower hem; the bottom edge is finished with a dense black shaggy fringe or feather-like trim that creates a textured, heavy border around the calves. The model carries an oversized vertical striped tote on one shoulder/arm, positioned along the left side of the body and extending from the shoulder area to below the hip; the bag features bold horizontal bands in yellow, navy, black, cream, and dark red, with dark handles and a visible tied detail near the lower front. Styling includes a chunky gold statement necklace at the collarbone, small metallic earrings, a bracelet or cuff at the wrist, and dark pointed high-heeled shoes visible beneath the swaying hem. The overall palette contrasts glossy black with warm multicolor stripes and gold jewelry, giving the look a polished, dramatic, artisanal runway mood.

The model carries an oversized vertical striped tote on one shoulder/arm, positioned along the left side of the body and extending from the shoulder area to below the hip; the bag features bold horizontal bands in yellow, navy, black, cream, and dark red, with dark handles and a visible tied detail near the lower front. Styling includes a chunky gold statement necklace at the collarbone, small metallic earrings, a bracelet or cuff at the wrist, and dark pointed high-heeled shoes visible beneath the swaying hem.
